a novel application of MRA in non-structural concrete, which can help to reduce the environmental footprint of the construction sector and to promote the circular economy.
the production and use of concrete with M RA and low cement content, which can help reduce environmental impact and the consumption of virgin natural aggregates.

the results obtained are promising and that they support the application of concrete made with 100% MRA and low-cement content in non-structured civil works, such as bike lanes or gutters, ground and leveling slabs, or subgrades for foundations.

the use of coarse MRA in low-cement concrete in upscaled applications, with the same mix design, facilities and procedures as in a real concrete production plant, has no significant effect on the mechanical properties, but it has a great influence in durability-related properties.

it is feasible to produce concrete slabs with 100% MRA incorporation and a low cement content, and this is possible with the same facilities and procedures as for conventional concretes.
